summary: Narrow solid rubber tire on a light-colored hub, 58 mm in diameter and 16 mm wide. Modeled as a cylinder with its rotation axis along y.

mountingSurfaces.description: Outer hub face, centered on the wheel axis. It is where the hub, screws and shaft attach. The opposite side (offset -8) is the other face.

notes: Diameter (58 mm) and width (16 mm) come from the supplied specs, which are marked unverified. The image shows a central hub opening and three screws or fasteners on the hub face, but no bore or screw-hole diameters or positions are given. The listing mentions interchangeable hubs for 4 mm round shafts and 3 mm hex shafts, but does not say which one is fitted. The holes array is therefore left empty rather than guessing. The axis choice (y) and the ±8 mm face offsets are modeling assumptions for a part centered at the origin.
